|translation='''Title:''' Reactor control panel.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on your side of the table. During your control phase, you may choose as many cards as you like from your hand and return them to the top of your Used Pile.

'''Lore:''' The Death Star has many control panels branching off from the main reactor, controlling the power supply of the immense space station.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese spells out choosing any desired number of cards from the hand; the English says any cards from your hand. Both specify a cost of 1 Force to deploy, the control phase, and the top of the Used Pile. The Japanese title and lore call the terminal a control panel.<ref name="comparison">[ Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 5:50.</ref>
